rationale: With US 10-year yields crossing 5% and WTI crude above $100 amid renewed Fed rate hikes and persistent inflation, the macro environment favors a balanced barbell strategy. We allocate to energy (XOM) and financials (JPM, BRK-B) to capture inflation and interest rate tailwinds. Concurrently, we maintain robust exposure to secular AI growth (MSFT, NVDA, AVGO, META) which display surprisingly reasonable valuations. Defensive growth and geopolitical hedges are provided by LLY, LMT, and GLD. This diversified, 10-position equal-weight portfolio is constructed to deliver risk-adjusted outperformance in a high-rate, elevated-inflation regime while capitalizing on the AI revolution.
